decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Ground Floor Plan, First Floor Plan, Roof Plan, All Elevations, Block Plan & Site Plan As Existing - 01 and Ground Floor Plan, First Floor Plan, Roof Plan, All Elevations, Block Plan & Site Plan As Proposed - 02 B Received: 9th August 2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension following the demolition of the garage to the house
